Both tests pass. Summary of what I implemented in `server.mjs`:

- **`listTools()`** returns two tool definitions (`note_create`, `note_get`) with full `inputSchema` (including `additionalProperties: false` as required by the mcp-builder skill).
- **`callTool(name, args)`** dispatches by name:
  - `note_create`: requires non-empty string `title` and `body`, generates a stable in-memory id (`n1`, `n2`, …) via a monotonic counter, stores `{id, title, body}` in a `Map`, returns text content `"Created note n1: <title>"`.
  - `note_get`: requires non-empty string `note_id`, looks it up in the map, returns text content with the stored title and body. Throws on unknown ids.
- **Validation**: empty/missing `title`, `body`, or `note_id` throws `"Invalid or missing '...'"`. Unknown tool name throws `"Unknown tool: <name>"`. All errors propagate up to `protocol.mjs`, which wraps them as JSON-RPC `-32602` errors.
